_meta.name: devanagari_ocr_corpus_v1
_meta.provenance: 24 invented Hindi and Marathi reference lines (hospital header, bill lines, medicine lines, letter lines, a patient name, Devanagari-digit dates, conjunct-heavy words, mixed Devanagari/Latin clinical values). Written by the engineering team, not reviewed by a native speaker. Ground-truth TEXT only: there are no images and no OCR output in this repository for it. No real patient, hospital, policy or document is involved.
_meta.description: Reference transcriptions for a Devanagari OCR benchmark (#35). error_kind is the line category, so evaluate_ocr(rows, hypotheses={id: ocr_text}) reports WER/CER per category. Rendering shaped Devanagari images from these lines needs a shaping engine (Raqm/HarfBuzz, a browser or a print-to-image path), and the current Kadi OCR reader is English-only (see docs/evaluation/multilingual-qa.md).
